correctness.rationale: 3-existential closure is equivalent to full-depth counting-free FO^4 equivalence to the random graph by the four-pebble game and eight 4-variable extension axioms. Expand eight times triple-pattern multiplicities using the three linear sums, pair quadratic sums -1, elliptic cubic sum T bounded by 2 sqrt(q), and three excluded base-vertex products bounded by 12: 8N>=q-15-2sqrt(q), hence N>=3 for q>=49. Independently exhaustive residue enumeration for p=29,37,41 over all triples and eight patterns gives minimum N=2 and EVERY unordered vertex pair as a complete two-witness set (406,666,820 pairs); affine automorphism square-scaling connects the two orbit representatives. One deletion thus leaves N>=1 and each two-deletion kills a witnessed pattern. Finite enumeration is exhaustive only at these orders, not a proof of q>=49.
